item.title: Return a library umbrella
item.context_text: You borrowed a green umbrella. Today your sister can take it back to the library.
item.objective_text: Find the return desk and tell your sister when to go.
success_conditions: Find the return desk and tell your sister when to go.

children.title: Read the situation
children.instructions: Read the information and answer both questions.
children.prompt_text:
LIBRARY HALL
Umbrellas: return to the blue desk by the front door before six. Books go to the red desk by the lift. Bring the small loan card with the umbrella.

questions.explanation: The sign sends umbrellas to the blue desk.

questions.prompt: Which item goes back with the umbrella?
questions.explanation: The sign says to bring the loan card.

children.title: Text your sister
children.instructions: Give the desk and the closing time.
children.goal: Tell her how to return it.
children.model_answer: Please take it to the blue desk by the front door before six today.

children.title: Talk to the library worker
children.instructions: Name the thing you are returning and offer the card.
children.model_answer: Hello, I'd like to return this umbrella. Here is the card.
